services.name: Hip Hopera: Babatunde Akinboboye
services.desc: Opera meets hip-hop in a groundbreaking live performance from viral sensation Babatunde Akinboboye. Internationally acclaimed for his genre-bending artistry, Babatunde Akinboboye is the creator of Hip Hopera-a fusion of classical opera and contemporary hip-hop that’s captivating audiences around the world. With powerful vocals, sharp charisma, and a fresh approach to performance art, Akinboboye delivers a one-of-a-kind musical experience that challenges tradition and redefines what it means to be a performer.
